actions.action: Enforce expiry locally, including during outages
actions.mechanism: Conservative clock deadlines and bounded screen-clearing latency prevent expired content from lingering without connectivity.
actions.implementation: Clear each expiring item by local expiry minus 30 seconds; initiate clearing earlier by the enforced rendering-latency bound. Revalidate before resume.
actions.check: Test both clock-error extremes, six-hour outages, stalled rendering, and sleep/resume; verify no item remains visible past its actual expiry.
actions.risk: Items disappear early; frozen displays require a functioning blanking watchdog.

actions.action: Make reconnection replace, not merge, cached configuration
actions.mechanism: Authoritative snapshots and durable monotonic generations reject rollback; omitted IDs are removed rather than retained.
actions.implementation: Publish complete snapshots with increasing generations. Persist snapshot and generation atomically. Server-side revision floors prohibit republishing revoked revisions; devices reject older generations.
actions.check: Remove an item, reconnect, replay an older snapshot, and reboot mid-update; the removed revision must never reappear after removal commits.
actions.risk: Device state loss needs authoritative bootstrap; offline emergency removal remains impossible.

actions.action: Stage and validate bundles before making them visible
actions.mechanism: An isolated candidate configuration prevents partial downloads or failed validation from changing the active announcement set.
actions.implementation: Cap encoded bundles below 100,000 bytes at publication and receipt. Validate completeness, unique IDs, revisions, and validity fields before atomic activation.
actions.check: Inject truncated, oversized, duplicate-ID, and malformed bundles; verify rejection leaves the previous configuration active with local expiry enforcement intact.
actions.risk: Oversized configurations need explicit publication failure, never silent truncation.

actions.action: Show freshness limits alongside offline announcements
actions.mechanism: Separate connectivity status from configuration age and distinguish timed validity from unknown revocation status.
actions.implementation: Display last successful authoritative verification and offline status. State: “Timed announcements expire locally; until-revoked announcements may have been withdrawn while offline.”
actions.check: During a six-hour outage, verify status persists, expired items disappear, and until-revoked items never receive an unqualified “current” label.
actions.risk: Freshness notices consume display space and cannot establish whether revocation occurred.
